verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.sumsub.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index. It states that appending .md to any docs page URL returns a markdown version, and the cited .md doc URLs show this works across the docs site. That gives an agent a clean llms.txt entry point plus markdown pages. Missing for 10: evidence of an llms-full.txt or equivalent full-corpus dump, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed OpenAPI paths returned 404).
